entries.text: Glasshouse Supply registers one purpose statement for its catalogue and defers the billing model of each item to that item's registered product record.
Glasshouse Propagation Tray: a moulded tray with drainage cells. The registered listing records neither a documented intended use nor an applicable billing model.
Registered product terms. Intended use: seedling propagation under cover. Billing model: a one-time purchase with no subscription.
